title: X-Factor Annual #4 Marvel 1989 Atlantis Attacks Dr Doom vs Magneto John Byrne
conditionDescription: Covers bright with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned at the edges. I have three copies in similar shape - you will receive one of them.
descriptionText:
X-Factor Annual #4 (1989), Marvel Comics - Atlantis Attacks part 6. 64 pages. "The Beast and Jean Grey face the wrath of Attuma!" Plus Inferno aftermath and Dr. Doom vs. Magneto. John Byrne cover. $2.00 cover price.

Back cover: TSR AD&D Spelljammer / Dragonlance / Greyhawk ad.

I have three copies of this issue in similar condition; the photos show one of them. Quantity available: 3.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
